name: world-protocol
description: Open protocol and TypeScript tooling for interoperable virtual worlds.

scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm --dir packages/worldkit-core test && pnpm --dir packages/worldkit-geo test && pnpm --dir packages/worldkit-spec test && pnpm --dir packages/worldkit-server test && pnpm --dir packages/worldkit-client test && pnpm --dir packages/worldkit-testing test && pnpm --dir examples/minimal-world test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build && pnpm --dir packages/worldkit-core typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/worldkit-geo typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/worldkit-spec typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/worldkit-server typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/worldkit-client typecheck && pnpm --dir packages/worldkit-testing typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm --dir packages/worldkit-core build && pnpm --dir packages/worldkit-geo build && pnpm --dir packages/worldkit-spec build && pnpm --dir packages/worldkit-server build && pnpm --dir packages/worldkit-client build && pnpm --dir packages/worldkit-testing build
